longDescription:
ResidualVM is a cross-platform 3D game interpreter which allows you to play LucasArts' Lua-based 3D adventures (provided you already have their data files):

* Grim Fandango * Myst III * Escape from Monkey Island (not working yet)

ResidualVM utilizes OpenGL for 3D graphics hardware acceleration. A software renderer is also included for machines without hardware OpenGL.
